messages:
ana: Heads-up  VertexChannel wants a joint POC: partner keys, SSO, short pilot addendum, and a quick pricing sketch. Goal: onboard next Tue.

mike (VertexChannel): Hi all! We need: 1) partner-scoped API key with 90k embeddings/day quota 2) SAML metadata support + SCIM for provisioning 3) one-pager with egress hostnames and data-retention terms.

owen: We'll do partner key & entitlement codes. Q: Hosted vs Dedicated for pilot? Hosted should be fine unless they require HSM.

mike (VertexChannel): Hosted is ideal. No HSM for pilot. Need audit logs retained 60 days.

sarah: Security note: we redact PII from logs by default, and we can export audit logs via S3 for their compliance team. I'll draft the security blurb.

ana: (typo) ana: owners proposal: entitlements & key: owen; SSO/SCIM onboarding: sarah; pricing one-pager + addendum draft: ana. Agree?

owen: Confirming entitlement: ENT-VC-PILOT -> embeddings:90k/day, gen_tokens:5k/day, burst:120rps. Creating key TTL 30d. CLI snippet: 
```
redwood-cli partner create-key --partner vertexchannel --entitlement ENT-VC-PILOT --ttl 30d --label "vc-pilot"
```

sarah: SSO steps: we support SAML and OIDC. For SAML: send SP metadata (https://sso.redwood.ai/saml/metadata). SCIM endpoints supported for user sync. Example SAML setup note: "Upload IdP metadata -> map email -> enable SCIM with group sync."

mike (VertexChannel): We'll provide IdP metadata tomorrow. Also legal asked for a 1-page addendum covering: pilot term 30 days, logs retention 60 days, liability cap, and data usage (no training).

ana: I'll draft addendum today. Pricing: ana will propose hosted pilot rate + partner discount. Need an example monthly calc for 90k embeddings/day with 30% cache hit.

ana: Draft calc (rough): 90k/day * 0.7 served = 63k embeddings/day 
- price $0.0006/embedding -> $37.8/day -> ~$1,134/month before partner discount. Add small gen buffer ~$50/month.

owen: Network hostnames to publish: api.redwood.ai, cdn.redwood.ai, logs.redwood.ai. Note: IPs may change; recommend hostname allowlist.

sarah: Security blurb to include: "Keys scoped & TTL-limited, rotate after pilot; logs redact PII; audit export available; HSM on Private only."

ops-bot: Created ticket PARTNER-9012 for key provisioning at 2123456900

mike (VertexChannel): Thanks  that looks good. Can we get addendum + key by EOD Monday? Pilot starts Tue.

owen: Will provision key and post key secret to partner vault. ETA Monday EOD.

ana: Draft addendum uploaded: https://redwood.shares/partners/vertexchannel/pilot-addendum-v1.pdf. Please review. Sync Monday 3pm PT to finalize. :thumbsup:
